dedupe_keys.name: structural performance monitoring and evaluation of scoured bridges under dynamic actions eries scour shake

description: This release tests slender and squat bridge-pier models with caisson foundations under varying scour and gravel-remediation conditions. Version 1.0 contains white-noise tests at 0.01 g target amplitude, including fixed-base and soil-box configurations. It supports checks of vibration-based scour identification and foundation-response models; stronger shaking phases are outside this version. The dataset is provided by UKCRIC Soil–Foundation–Structure Interaction (SoFSI-Soil Pit) Laboratory through BED. BED assigns the experiment to 2024. The provider metadata identifies compressed archives, images or recordings. Zenodo lists open file access with no stated charge. Actual file retrieval was not tested. BED currently reports that its dataset download was not found; the separate Zenodo metadata is retained. The stated licence is CC BY 4.0. The measurements support calibration or checking of infrastructure response models. Sampling resolution is not established here unless stated above; file-level quality remains unverified. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
